"""Controller for the VLABench select_billiards_spatial episode.

Uses only the standard robot client, camera observations, and robot proprioception.
"""
from __future__ import annotations
import numpy as np
from rcb_client import Robot

DT = 0.1

def connect():
    return Robot()

def move_joints(robot, target, seconds, *, cameras=None, video="none", note=""):
    """Hold a joint-position target for seconds; seconds is rounded to control ticks."""
    n = max(1, int(round(seconds / DT)))
    actions = np.repeat(np.asarray(target, dtype=float)[None, :], n, axis=0)
    return robot.submit("joint_position", actions, dt=DT, interpolate="linear",
                        cameras=cameras, video=video, note=note)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    # The live episode is driven interactively; keep this file as the run record.
    r = connect()
    print(r.spec())

"""Controller for the VLABench select_billiards_spatial episode.

Uses only the standard robot client, camera observations, and robot proprioception.
"""
from __future__ import annotations
import numpy as np
from rcb_client import Robot

DT = 0.1

# Task geometry and the visually identified striped 14 ball.
POCKET_XY = np.array([0.52, -0.99])
BALL_RADIUS_M = 0.03
BALL_XYZ_ESTIMATE = np.array([-0.135, 0.033, 0.631])  # latest forward-camera RGB/depth estimate
PUSH_AXIS_XY = (POCKET_XY - BALL_XYZ_ESTIMATE[:2])
PUSH_AXIS_XY = PUSH_AXIS_XY / np.linalg.norm(PUSH_AXIS_XY)

def connect():
    return Robot()

def move_joints(robot, target, seconds, *, cameras=None, video="none", note=""):
    """Hold a joint-position target for seconds; seconds is rounded to control ticks."""
    n = max(1, int(round(seconds / DT)))
    actions = np.repeat(np.asarray(target, dtype=float)[None, :], n, axis=0)
    return robot.submit("joint_position", actions, dt=DT, interpolate="linear",
                        cameras=cameras, video=video, note=note)

def now(robot):
    """Return the latest proprioceptive vector as a name-to-value mapping."""
    meta = robot.status()
    # Status deliberately contains no current pose; a free observation does.
    obs = robot.get_obs(cameras=[], video="none")
    layout = obs.meta["proprio"]["layout"]
    return dict(zip(layout, obs.meta["proprio"]["now"]))

def _quat_conj(q):
    q = np.asarray(q, dtype=float)
    return np.array([q[0], -q[1], -q[2], -q[3]])

def _quat_mul(a, b):
    aw, ax, ay, az = np.asarray(a, dtype=float)
    bw, bx, by, bz = np.asarray(b, dtype=float)
    return np.array([aw*bw-ax*bx-ay*by-az*bz,
                     aw*bx+ax*bw+ay*bz-az*by,
                     aw*by-ax*bz+ay*bw+az*bx,
                     aw*bz+ax*by-ay*bx+az*bw])

def rotation_error(target, current):
    """World-frame rotation vector taking current orientation to target."""
    q = _quat_mul(np.asarray(target), _quat_conj(np.asarray(current)))
    q = q / max(np.linalg.norm(q), 1e-12)
    if q[0] < 0:
        q = -q
    sn = np.linalg.norm(q[1:])
    if sn < 1e-10:
        return 2*q[1:]
    return q[1:] * (2*np.arctan2(sn, q[0])/sn)

def estimate_pose_jacobian(robot, q=None, probe=0.025, settle=0.3):
    """Estimate d(tcp pose)/d(joints) using small, reversible in-air probes."""
    p = now(robot)
    if q is None:
        q = np.array([p[f"joint{i}_pos"] for i in range(1, 8)])
    else:
        q = np.asarray(q, dtype=float)
    xyz0 = np.array([p["tcp_x"], p["tcp_y"], p["tcp_z"]])
    quat0 = np.array([p[f"tcp_q{i}"] for i in ("w", "x", "y", "z")])
    fingers = np.array([p["finger1_pos"], p["finger2_pos"]])
    base = np.r_[q, fingers]
    hold_rows = max(3, int(round(settle / DT)))
    actions = []
    for j in range(7):
        q1 = q.copy(); q1[j] += probe
        actions.extend([np.r_[q1, fingers]]*hold_rows)
        actions.extend([base]*hold_rows)
    # One short trajectory captures all reversible probes in one service call.
    # At 10 Hz, proprio includes the start and every 0.1 s boundary.
    out = robot.submit("joint_position", np.asarray(actions), dt=DT,
                       interpolate="linear", cameras=[], video="none", video_fps=10,
                       note="Reversible in-air pose Jacobian calibration")
    rows = np.asarray(out.proprio)
    layout = out.meta["proprio"]["layout"]
    idx = {name: i for i, name in enumerate(layout)}
    dqs = np.zeros((7, 7)); dposes = np.zeros((6, 7))
    for j in range(7):
        i0 = 2*j*hold_rows
        i1 = i0 + hold_rows
        b, a = rows[i0], rows[i1]
        q_before = np.array([b[idx[f"joint{i}_pos"]] for i in range(1, 8)])
        q_after = np.array([a[idx[f"joint{i}_pos"]] for i in range(1, 8)])
        dq_actual = q_after-q_before
        if abs(dq_actual[j]) < 1e-5:
            raise RuntimeError(f"joint {j+1} probe did not move")
        xyz_before = np.array([b[idx[k]] for k in ("tcp_x", "tcp_y", "tcp_z")])
        xyz_after = np.array([a[idx[k]] for k in ("tcp_x", "tcp_y", "tcp_z")])
        quat_before = np.array([b[idx[f"tcp_q{k}"]] for k in ("w", "x", "y", "z")])
        quat_after = np.array([a[idx[f"tcp_q{k}"]] for k in ("w", "x", "y", "z")])
        dqs[:, j] = dq_actual
        dposes[:3, j] = xyz_after-xyz_before
        dposes[3:, j] = rotation_error(quat_after, quat_before)
    end = rows[-1]
    q = np.array([end[idx[f"joint{i}_pos"]] for i in range(1, 8)])
    xyz0 = np.array([end[idx[k]] for k in ("tcp_x", "tcp_y", "tcp_z")])
    J = dposes @ np.linalg.pinv(dqs)
    return q, xyz0, J

def pose_ik_step(q, J, delta_xyz, delta_rot=(0, 0, 0), damping=0.035, orientation_weight=1.0):
    """Damped least-squares differential IK for a small Cartesian pose increment."""
    d = np.r_[np.asarray(delta_xyz, dtype=float), orientation_weight*np.asarray(delta_rot, dtype=float)]
    Jw = J.copy(); Jw[3:] *= orientation_weight
    return np.asarray(q, dtype=float) + Jw.T @ np.linalg.solve(Jw @ Jw.T + damping**2*np.eye(6), d)

def cartesian_step(robot, target_xyz, target_quat, J, seconds=0.8, fingers=None,
                   orientation_weight=1.0, note="Cartesian step"):
    """Take one feedback-controlled Cartesian pose step and report measured pose."""
    p = now(robot)
    q = np.array([p[f"joint{i}_pos"] for i in range(1, 8)])
    xyz = np.array([p["tcp_x"], p["tcp_y"], p["tcp_z"]])
    quat = np.array([p[f"tcp_q{k}"] for k in ("w", "x", "y", "z")])
    if fingers is None:
        fingers = (p["finger1_pos"], p["finger2_pos"])
    qdesired = pose_ik_step(q, J, np.asarray(target_xyz)-xyz,
                            rotation_error(target_quat, quat),
                            orientation_weight=orientation_weight)
    dq = qdesired - q
    max_step = np.max(np.abs(dq))
    if max_step > 0.18:
        dq *= 0.18/max_step
    limits = np.array([[-2.8973, 2.8973], [-1.7628, 1.7628],
                       [-2.8973, 2.8973], [-3.0718, -0.0698],
                       [-2.8973, 2.8973], [-0.0175, 3.7525],
                       [-2.8973, 2.8973]])
    qcmd = np.clip(q+dq, limits[:, 0]+0.01, limits[:, 1]-0.01)
    out = move_joints(robot, np.r_[qcmd, *fingers], seconds, note=note)
    pp = dict(zip(out.meta["proprio"]["layout"], out.meta["proprio"]["now"]))
    qactual = np.array([pp[f"joint{i}_pos"] for i in range(1, 8)])
    xyzactual = np.array([pp["tcp_x"], pp["tcp_y"], pp["tcp_z"]])
    quatactual = np.array([pp[f"tcp_q{k}"] for k in ("w", "x", "y", "z")])
    return qactual, xyzactual, quatactual, out

def drive_pose_to(robot, target_xyz, target_quat=None, *, max_step=0.03,
                  recalibrate_every=4, seconds=0.8, min_z=0.70, note="Cartesian path"):
    """Move through small pose increments, updating the local Jacobian from feedback."""
    target_xyz = np.asarray(target_xyz, dtype=float)
    p = now(robot)
    xyz = np.array([p["tcp_x"], p["tcp_y"], p["tcp_z"]])
    quat = np.array([p[f"tcp_q{k}"] for k in ("w", "x", "y", "z")])
    if target_quat is None:
        target_quat = quat.copy()
    else:
        target_quat = np.asarray(target_quat, dtype=float)
    q = np.array([p[f"joint{i}_pos"] for i in range(1, 8)])
    J = None
    since_cal = recalibrate_every
    count = 0
    while np.linalg.norm(target_xyz-xyz) > 0.008:
        if since_cal >= recalibrate_every or J is None:
            q, xyz, J = estimate_pose_jacobian(robot, q=q, probe=0.02, settle=0.4)
            p = now(robot)
            xyz = np.array([p["tcp_x"], p["tcp_y"], p["tcp_z"]])
            quat = np.array([p[f"tcp_q{k}"] for k in ("w", "x", "y", "z")])
            q = np.array([p[f"joint{i}_pos"] for i in range(1, 8)])
            since_cal = 0
        delta = target_xyz-xyz
        delta *= min(1.0, max_step/max(np.linalg.norm(delta), 1e-9))
        old_q, old_xyz, old_quat = q.copy(), xyz.copy(), quat.copy()
        q, xyz, quat, out = cartesian_step(robot, xyz+delta, target_quat, J,
                                           seconds=seconds, note=f"{note} step {count+1}")
        dq = q-old_q
        dpose = np.r_[xyz-old_xyz, rotation_error(quat, old_quat)]
        den = float(dq@dq)
        if den > 1e-8:
            J += np.outer(dpose-J@dq, dq)/den
        since_cal += 1
        count += 1
        pos_err = float(np.linalg.norm(target_xyz-xyz))
        orient_err = float(np.linalg.norm(rotation_error(target_quat, quat)))
        print(f"{note} {count}: tcp={xyz.tolist()} remaining={pos_err:.3f}m orient={orient_err:.3f}rad")
        if out.done:
            break
        if xyz[2] < min_z:
            raise RuntimeError(f"Cartesian path crossed minimum safe z={min_z}: {xyz}")
        if count > 100:
            raise RuntimeError("Cartesian path exceeded 100 increments")
    return q, xyz, quat
